description.zh: 玻璃包装是高端美妆品牌的首选材质，具有优异的化学惰性和阻隔性，能有效保护活性成分不被氧化，同时赋予产品高端奢华的视觉质感。
description.en: Glass is the preferred material for premium beauty brands, offering excellent chemical inertness and barrier properties to protect active ingredients from oxidation while delivering a luxurious visual appeal.

zh: 高端质感，提升品牌形象
化学惰性，不与成分反应
多色可选（透明/琥珀/深蓝/黑色）
en: Premium feel that elevates brand image

typicalUse.zh: 精华瓶、面霜罐、香水瓶、高端乳液瓶
typicalUse.en: Serum bottles, face cream jars, perfume bottles, premium lotion bottles

description.zh: 亚克力又称有机玻璃，具有极高的透明度和玻璃质感，同时重量仅为玻璃的一半，耐摔性更强。是中高端护肤品牌的性价比之选。
description.en: Acrylic, also known as organic glass, features exceptional clarity and glass-like appearance at half the weight of glass with better shatter resistance. A cost-effective choice for mid-to-premium skincare brands.

zh: 高透明度，接近玻璃质感
en: High transparency, close to glass appearance
Easy to mold into complex shapes

zh: 长期使用可能出现细纹
en: Not resistant to some organic solvents

typicalUse.zh: 面霜罐、眼霜罐、乳液瓶、套装包装
typicalUse.en: Face cream jars, eye cream jars, lotion bottles, packaging sets

description.zh: PP 是美妆包材中最常用的塑料材质之一，具有优异的耐化学品性和食品级安全认证，广泛用于可补充包装和内胆设计，符合当下可持续包装趋势。
description.en: PP is one of the most widely used plastics in beauty packaging, featuring excellent chemical resistance and food-grade safety certification, widely used in refillable packaging and inner container design.

zh: 耐化学品，适合多种配方
成本低，适合大批量生产
en: Chemical resistant, compatible with diverse formulations
Low cost, suitable for mass production

zh: 透明度差，不适合展示产品颜色
en: Poor transparency, not suitable for showcasing product color

typicalUse.zh: 可补充内胆、泵头配件、洗护发瓶、软管
typicalUse.en: Refillable inserts, pump components, hair care bottles, tubes

name.zh: PET（聚对苯二甲酸乙二醇酯）

description.zh: PET 兼具良好的透明度和轻量化特性，是塑料瓶中最接近玻璃效果的材质，广泛用于乳液、爽肤水等护肤产品包装。
description.en: PET combines good transparency with lightweight properties, the closest plastic to glass in appearance, widely used for lotion, toner and skincare product packaging.

zh: 高透明度，展示产品颜色
表面可做多种处理（磨砂/喷涂）
en: High transparency for showcasing product color
Good barrier properties for formula protection
Surface can be treated in multiple ways
Not heat resistant (not suitable for hot filling)

typicalUse.zh: 乳液瓶、爽肤水瓶、泡沫泵瓶、洗护发瓶
typicalUse.en: Lotion bottles, toner bottles, foam pump bottles, hair care bottles

description.zh: HDPE 具有极强的耐化学品性和硬度，是家清和洗护类大包装的主流材质，成本低廉，安全可靠。
description.en: HDPE features exceptional chemical resistance and rigidity, the mainstream material for large-format household care and hair care packaging, cost-effective and reliable.

typicalUse.zh: 洗发水瓶、沐浴露瓶、家清包装、大容量补充装
typicalUse.en: Shampoo bottles, body wash bottles, household care packaging, large refill containers

description.zh: 铝质包装兼具轻量化和高端金属质感，100% 可无限回收，是可持续高端美妆包装的理想选择，尤其适合旅行装和限量版产品。
description.en: Aluminum packaging combines lightweight properties with premium metallic aesthetics, 100% infinitely recyclable, ideal for sustainable premium beauty packaging, especially travel sizes and limited editions.

zh: 可做哑光/高光多种处理

en: Requires inner coating to prevent corrosion

typicalUse.zh: 口红管、香水瓶、旅行装套装、限量版包装
typicalUse.en: Lipstick tubes, perfume bottles, travel size sets, limited edition packaging
